kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يكتئب (form VIII)
# يَكْتَئِبُ (yaktaʔibu) /jak.ta.ʔi.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# يَكْتَئِبَ (yaktaʔiba) /jak.ta.ʔi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# يَكْتَئِبْ (yaktaʔib) /jak.ta.ʔib/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
